note: Inputs of batch `closeout_v1`. One derived extra-data series (BIL*, IB24_2L's leg B) and one downloaded intraday sample that is *evidence* for the IC54 closure, not a screening input (it covers ~60 days, so it cannot make IC54/A-B evaluable). No other input was added or re-downloaded; every market series the arms read is already committed.

inputs.name: BILSTAR_DAILY
inputs.construction: BIL*_d = BIL*_{d-1} * (1 + (DTB3_d - 0.1356 %/yr) / 365), on every calendar day; BIL*_0 = 1.0 at 1934-01-01 (tbill_sweep_v1's BIL* = DTB3 - 0.1356 %/yr, accrued per calendar day instead of per session so one date-keyed series answers every window's own session calendar); written with LF line endings (the repository normalises CRLF, which would change the file's hash)
inputs.rate_schedule: fe_data.rate_on over fe_data.load_rates(): DTB3 forward-filled from 1954-01-04 on, TB3MS before that -- the same schedule every window reads into its own `rate` column

sources.series: DTB3 (3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate, daily)
TB3MS (3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate, monthly)

inputs.registered_as: EXTRA_DATA.json series BILSTAR_DAILY, key `bilstar` (leg_b of research/ideas/IB24_2L.py)

inputs.name: closeout_v1_yahoo_qqq_30m.json
inputs.kind: download (evidence only, not a screening input)
inputs.purpose: IC54/A-B closure: the same API refuses a 5-year 30-minute range with "30m data not available ... The requested range must be within the last 60 days." (see research/closeout_v1/ic54_closure.py --fetch). The 60-day sample is kept so the refusal and the served range are on the record.

not_downloaded.alpaca_sip_bars: the LIVE path's intraday source has no offline access in this repository (no credentials, no vendored bars); recorded by ic54_closure --scan
not_downloaded.intraday_inventory: 98 CSVs under data/ carry no time-of-day column and none of the 82 registered batch_screen extra series is intraday (ic54_closure --scan)
